Interlude in Venice: Freelance troubleshooter Simon Templar embarks on another case. The Saint visits Venice to save a damsel in distress but is then plunged into a seedy underworld.

Lady in the Squad Room: Kojak doesn't approve of a female detective joining his team, but they must cooperate if they are to nail a murderous drug dealer.
The Russian Prisoner: Cult 60s detective series. The Saint takes a holiday to Switzerland where he meets a beautiful girl and a Russian professor who plans to defect to the West.
Queens Gambit: A business friend of Harry's turns to Boon for help after a series of dangerous incidents which seem to be part of a hate campaign against him.
